research_rationale:
EO 10999 (Assigning Emergency Preparedness Functions to the Secretary of Commerce, signed 1962-02-16, 27 FR 1527-1532) was read in full from the held official Federal Register extract (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_10999.txt, 24,413 chars; page images not inspected). The extract begins with the tail of EO 10998 (Agriculture, Secs. 8-12) and ends with the opening of EO 11000 (Labor); neither is part of EO 10999. The machine draft inventory had 46 records with duplicated sub-items that mixed those neighbours, so I replaced it with the 13 sections of EO 10999 (Secs. 1-13) using absolute character spans in the held file. EO 10999 has no sunset. Its first end is EO 11490 (signed 1969-10-28, 34 FR 17567): Sec. 3015 'The following are hereby revoked:' lists '(7) Executive Order No. 10999 of February 16, 1962' (official Federal Register text jobs/family-rule-tail/output/texts/EO_11490_tail.txt, and the APP transcription); the OLRC note at 42 U.S.C. 5195 note independently records that EO 10999 'was revoked by Ex. Ord. No. 11490, Oct. 28, 1969, 34 F.R. 17567'. EO 11490 states no effective date or delay, so it took effect on signing, 1969-10-28. Sec. 3014 (retention of existing authority) is expressly 'except as provided by Section 3015' and so does not save EO 10999. Search scope: current-law:usc (one editorial note stating the revocation), current-law:ecfr (no section in the eCFR search hits lists EO 10999), later-events:ofr_catalog (all hits are EO 11490); none has a coverage warning. The dossier's missing item (EO 10952, a Department of Defense order named in Sec. 6) is only a cross-reference and is not an acting instrument for EO 10999.

No earlier revoking, superseding or amending instrument: a full-text search of the held Federal Register order texts for '10999' finds only the EO 10997/10998/10999 neighbouring extracts, EO 11327 and EO 9602/9784 (incidental page text) and EO 14257 (a tariff code); EO 11310 (revoked by the same section) and EO 11087-11095 (other agencies' assignments) do not name EO 10999. The OFR catalog search (5 hits), the U.S. Code note at 42 U.S.C. 5195 note and the 1989 Codification all point only to EO 11490. savings.reason: EO 11490 Sec. 3015 revokes EO 10999 without a saving clause for it; Sec. 3014 preserves only other existing assignments 'except as provided by Section 3015'. The emergency-preparedness functions of the Secretary of Commerce are re-assigned in Part 9 of EO 11490 (transferred), and Sec. 13's revocation of Emergency Preparedness Order No. 2 was executed in 1962 (accrued). No independent command remains.
